<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="order-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="order-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="order-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>placeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="system" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>generateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>generateLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="logistics" name="Logistics provider">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>deliver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>monitorMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Order process begins" />
    <bpmn:task id="placeOrder" name="Place the order" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="generateConfirmation" name="Generate the order confirmation" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="sendConfirmation" name="Send the order confirmation to the customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="pickPack" name="Pick and pack the items" />
    <bpmn:task id="generateLabel" name="Generate the shipping label" />
    <bpmn:task id="handOver" name="Hand over the order to the logistics provider" />
    <bpmn:task id="deliver" name="Deliver the shipment" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="sendTracking" name="Send the tracking information to the customer" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="monitorMerge" name="Monitor shipment" />
    <bpmn:task id="monitor" name="Monitor the shipment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="delivered" name="Shipment reached the customer's address?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Successful delivery" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="placeOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="placeOrder" targetRef="generateConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="generateConfirmation" targetRef="sendConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="sendConfirmation" targetRef="pickPack" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="pickPack" targetRef="generateLabel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="generateLabel" targetRef="handOver" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="handOver" targetRef="deliver" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="deliver" targetRef="sendTracking" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="sendTracking" targetRef="monitorMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="monitorMerge" targetRef="monitor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="monitor" targetRef="delivered" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" name="Yes" sourceRef="delivered" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="No" sourceRef="delivered" targetRef="monitorMerge" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
